cands.name: Brian Hawkins
cands.bio: Republican; Hernando County commissioner (District 2) since 2022 and past commission chair, resigned to run. U.S. Navy veteran and business owner/CEO.

record.text: Elected to the Hernando County Commission in 2022; resigned in 2026 to run for HD 53 after Rep. Jeff Holcomb left to run for county commission.
His campaign site says that as chairman he delivered the largest property-tax reduction in the state and cut county debt below 3% (self-reported, not verified).
